name: Gingerich's Organic Strawberries and Flowers

description: A family-run berry farm in Nappanee, IN, Gingerich's Organic Strawberries and Flowers grows Strawberries, Flowers, and Sunflowers. The farm is busiest in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
